mine_hero_exp.Description: <text|A large mine shaft that is constantly running.|edfont_18_brown>
mine_hero_exp.Description1: Lvl 5 Prosper: Yield +5%. Grants 1 new stack per hour, up to 6 stacks. Loses 3 stacks if pillaged.
mine_hero_exp.Description2: Lvl 10 Prosper: Yield +5%. Grants 1 new stack per hour, up to 8 stacks. Loses 3 stacks if pillaged.

tower_power.Name: Energy Tower
tower_power.Description1: Lvl 5 Abundance: Buildings within 1 adjoining tile +2 levels (excludes Energy Towers)

tower_magic.Name: Radiation Tower
tower_magic.Description1: Lvl 5 Sanctuary: Prosperity -1 when a Resource Building in an adjacent tile is plundered.
tower_magic.Description2: Lvl 10 Sanctuary: Prosperity -2 when a Resource Building in an adjacent tile is plundered.

tower_faith.Name: Ominous Tower
tower_faith.Description1: Lvl 5 Cower: If a resource building within 1 tile is successfully defended, the pillager loses 5 Morale.
tower_faith.Description2: Lvl 10 Cower: If a resource building within 1 tile is successfully defended, the pillager loses 7 Morale.

stone_blood.Name: Tablet of Death
stone_blood.Description1: Lvl 5 Illusion of Death: Let the pillager face death. Morale -2 when stepped on.
stone_blood.Description2: Lvl 10 Illusion of Death: Let the pillager face death. Morale -4 when stepped on.

stone_weak.Name: Inertia Stone
stone_weak.Description1: Lvl 5 Inertia: When stepped on, max of 4 on next dice roll.
stone_weak.Description2: Lvl 10 Inertia: When stepped on, max of 3 on next dice roll.

stone_curse.Name: Enmity Stone
stone_curse.Description1: Lvl 5 Curse: Curses a hero. Morale -5 when the cursed hero is deployed.
stone_curse.Description2: Lvl 10 Curse: Curses a hero. Morale -10 when the cursed hero is deployed.

flower_red.Name: Crimson Flower
flower_red.DescriptionBasic: <text|If you have over 10 Morale, you will receive |bigrichman_desc><text|{0}%|tower_tip2><text| extra points.|bigrichman_desc>
flower_red.Description1: Lvl 5 Celerity: When pillaging, +2 dice rolls (cannot stack)
flower_red.Description2: Lvl 10 Celerity: When pillaging, +3 dice rolls (cannot stack)

flower_blue.Name: Energy Flower
flower_blue.DescriptionBasic: <text|If you have over 10 Morale, you will receive |bigrichman_desc><text|{0}%|tower_tip2><text| extra points.|bigrichman_desc>
flower_blue.Description1: Lvl 5 Iron Will: When pillaging, your Morale won't drop below 4.
flower_blue.Description2: Lvl 10 Blessing of Perseverance: When pillaging, your Morale won't drop below 7.

flower_yellow.Name: Prayer Flower
flower_yellow.Description: <text|A flower that offers blessings and hope.|edfont_18_brown>

wharf.Name: Shipyard
wharf.DescriptionBasic: <text|The ship is almost ready to set sail, let's hope it comes back full of loot!|edfont_18_brown>

stable.Name: Stables
stable.DescriptionBasic: <text|It's time to swap your mount for a well-rested one, or a brand new dice?|edfont_18_brown>

factory.Name: Workshop
factory.Description: <text|When stepped on, a random building is upgraded.|bigrichman_desc>
factory.DescriptionBasic: <text|A workshop that has unmatched efficiency, just try to ignore its randomness...|edfont_18_brown>

fountain.Name: Fountain of Blessing
fountain.Description: <text|A fountain that flows with pristine water.|edfont_18_brown>
fountain.Description1: Lvl 5 Tranquility: Max Prosper +2, but Max Morale -2
fountain.Description2: Lvl 10 Tranquility: Prosper Limit +4, but Max Morale -4

fountain_war.Name: Fountain of War
fountain_war.Description: <text|Cast on the spring water is the God of War's shadow.|edfont_18_brown>
fountain_war.DescriptionBasic: <text|For each point of Morale, Pillaged Loot |bigrichman_desc><text|+{0}%.|tower_tip2>
fountain_war.Description1: Lvl 5 Bugle: Max Prosper -2, but Max Morale +2
fountain_war.Description2: Lvl 10 Bugle: Max Prosper -3, but Max Morale +3
